snippet.title: Bad News Baseball (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Tecmo, Jun 1990 (Original Hardware)
snippet.description:
Bad News Baseball was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in June 1990. All audio/visual elements copyright 1990, Tecmo. Music composed by Mayuko Okamura, Miyako Endo, More Yamasan.

https://nesguide.com/games/bad-news-baseball/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT BAD NEWS BASEBALL (NES)

Looking for a baseball game that will challenge your skills and tickle your funnybone? You've finally found it. Bad News Baseball is the new cartoon-style, outrageously funny baseball game only from Tecmo. It's fast-paced and jam-packed full of new animated cinema displays and exciting action. And now, Bad News Baseball has boys uand/u girls teams! Play against the computer, play with a buddy, or use the spectator mode, but you had better get ready to laugh. Featuring 12 boys teams and 12 girls teams, 11 different pitches and Tecmo's famous instant close-ups, all you need is a hotdog and you're ready to play!

AKA: Gekitou!! Stadium
